prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1488; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits. Please also confirm whether any other policies may apply to this loss, including umbrella or excess coverage.

Finally, we request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials while the matter is pending.
